title: 有馬記念の後に・迷走の始まり

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka loses to Daiwa Scarlet. What's more, she claims that, having no sound goals, she deserved the loss.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Feeling that she cannot continue to race the way she has been, Vodka decides that she needs to be more clear about the type of coolness she is truly searching for.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I recommend the Victoria Mile for her next race, where she can sprint full speed ahead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka decides to spend the time before the race trying to figure out what she really wants to strive for.
